title: PGIMER Recruitment 2026 – MTS, Pharmacist and More Posts
shortInfo: PGIMER has announced notification for MTS, Pharmacist and More posts. Required qualification: M.Sc, D.Pharm, 10TH, B.Lib, PG Diploma. Last date to apply: 19-10-26.

dates.event: Opening Date for Online Registration & Submission of Online Application
Closing Date for Online Registration & Submission of Online Applications

howToApply: Visit PGIMER’s official website at www.pgimer.edu.in and click on the Recruitment link at the Home Page.

Register online by filling in mandatory details: Advertisement No., Advertisement Date, Name of Applicant (as per matriculation certificate), Date of Birth (as per matriculation certificate), Mobile No. & Email ID.
After successful registration, an acknowledgement will be sent to the registered Email ID with User ID and Password.
Login using the credentials received and click on ‘Go to Application Form’.
Fill in the application form section-wise: personal information, qualification(s), experience(s), and upload required documents/certificates.
Upload scanned passport-size coloured photograph (JPEG, 50-80 KB, taken on or after 01.06.2026) with name and date written on it.
Upload legible scanned copies of all required certificates (Matric onwards, category certificate, experience certificates, NOC if employed, etc.).
After completing all sections, click ‘Submit’ and proceed to make the payment through Net Banking/Credit Card/Debit Card.
Take a printout of the completed application form for future reference.
Candidates in employment must also forward their application through proper channel to the Administrative Officer, Recruitment Cell within 10 days after the last date of online submission.

title: AAI NR Recruitment 2026 – Graduate Apprentice, Diploma Apprentice, ITI Trade Apprentice Posts
shortInfo: AAI NR has announced notification for Graduate Apprentice, Diploma Apprentice, ITI Trade Apprentice posts. Required qualification: Degree, Diploma, ITI. Last date to apply: 16-09-26.
howToApply: Visit BOAT’s/RDAT’s web portal: www.nats.education.gov.in (for Graduate/Diploma Apprentices) or www.apprenticeshipindia.org (for ITI Trade Apprentices).
Register yourself on the concerned portal (NATS/NAPS) prior to applying for apprenticeship training in AAI.
Find establishment: Airports Authority of India – RHQ NR, New Delhi (NDLSWC000002(BOAT) / E05200700101(NAPS)) and click on the Apply button.
Complete your profile with all required details including educational qualifications, communication details, and training preferences.
Upload required documents including qualifying degree/provisional certificate in PDF format.
After successful application, the portal will display the message: ‘Successfully applied for the training position. Based on availability, you will be contacted by the establishment.’
Candidates applying for more than one discipline will not be considered and their application will be rejected.
No Application Fee is being charged.

After applying on the NATS/NAPS portal, also submit your details along with preferred State and three preferred locations in the Microsoft Office Form at: https://forms.cloud.microsoft/r/pw7D2cUK7c by 06.09.2026, 05:00 PM.
Candidates can apply for ONLY ONE DISCIPLINE CODE. Multiple discipline code applications will be summarily rejected.
Ensure you have a valid PAN Card, Aadhaar Card, active Aadhaar-seeded bank account enabled for DBT, and APAAR ID updated on NATS portal.
Applications must be submitted on or before 06th September 2026 at 05:00 PM. Applications received after the last date will not be considered.
